ai_review.summary: Outstanding front‑of‑house audience capture with big, clear Phil bass; musical performance not detailed
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates this recording a perfect five stars, preferring the FOB (front‑of‑house) audience mix to traditional soundboard tapes. They highlight a strong Phil Lesh bass presence that remains well‑balanced and not overly boomy, indicating excellent clarity in the crowd capture. No specific comments on song performance or set flow were provided.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 5‑star review praises the audience capture and instrument balance; lack of show details limits certainty.
